claims.summary: The Japan Foundation’s passive chart forms Group 2 passives by replacing -る with -られる and gives 見る→見られる; it also notes that Group 2 passive and potential forms coincide formally.

locators.description: Elementary 2, Lesson 7, tabla “How to make the passive-form ①”, PDF p. 144 (página impresa L7-21), líneas 11373–11401: grupo 2 -る a -られる y ejemplo 見る→見られる; p. 157 (L8-17), líneas 12493–12495, explica que la forma pasiva y potencial de grupo 2 coincide formalmente.
